description:
Connected social accounts. list: every account with the ids and names to publish with. connect: an OAuth link to open, or a direct connect with the credential fields below. disconnect: removes an account. get_persona_publishing / set_persona_publishing: the accounts a persona publishes to by default (set replaces them all). list_boards: the boards of a Pinterest account.
Actions and their required fields: list (no required fields); connect (provider); disconnect (account); get_persona_publishing (persona); set_persona_publishing (persona, accounts); list_boards (account).

accessToken.description: rumble only: the upload access token (from bd@rumble.com). Never logged.

account.description: The account to disconnect, by name or id (accounts list shows both).

accounts.description: Publishing accounts the persona is bound to, per provider, e.g. { youtube: ["UC..."], bluesky: ["did:plc:..."] }. Replaces the whole set: providers mapped to [] (or omitted) keep no binding for that provider, but the binding as a whole must keep at least one account. Account IDs come from accounts (action: list) (channelId / igUserId / providerAccountId / did).

action.description: What to do: list | connect | disconnect | get_persona_publishing | set_persona_publishing | list_boards. The description lists the fields each action needs.

appPassword.description: bluesky only: an app password (Settings > App passwords). Never logged.

botToken.description: telegram only: the @BotFather bot token. Never logged.

chatId.description: telegram only: @username or numeric chat ID.

persona.description: The persona, by name or id (personas list shows both).

postingKey.description: 3speak only: the Hive posting key (never the owner/active/master key). Never logged.

provider.description: Only the accounts of this network.

name: accounts
